question: The marked price of a toy truck is ₹8,730, and its selling price is ₹5,940. Find the discount percentage. (Round off the answer to two decimal places.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of MP to SP = 8730 : 5940

⇒ MP : SP = 873 : 594 = 97 : 66

Discount in ratio parts = 97 − 66 = 31

Discount % = (31 ÷ 97) × 100 ≈ 31.958%

**∴ The correct answer is 31.96%.**
